title: Rabbi Yudan of Kefar Imi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 16:6 relates that once a fire broke out, he spread his cloak over his stack of grain, and the fire fled. At the end of Nedarim 4:9 the reading is Rabbi Yonah of Kefar Imi. Hyman states that the initials R”Y undoubtedly stood there and were expanded to Rabbi Yonah.
